READ FIRST: Before your invitation can be accepted, you must:

1. Join the Epic Games organization: https://www.unrealengine.com/en-US/ue-on-github
2. Set your Epic Games membership visibility to **public** (required for automated verification). The GitHub website often fails for Epic Games because of its size — see the automated comment on your issue for the API command.

After both steps, comment on your issue to trigger verification.
